01

“Their call therein will be 'Glory to You, O God'”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 10:10).

346
Explanation from Sufyān No. 346: 1: 4

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
346: 1:4. Sufyan, on His words
"Their call therein will be 'Glory to You, O God'": He said, when they desire something they say "Glory to You, O God," and then it is before them (verse 10).
العربية
346: 1: 4 سفيان فِي قَوْلِهِ دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللهم قَالَ إِذَا اشْتَهَوْا شَيْئًا قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ فَإِذَا هُوَ بَيْنَ أيديهم (الآية 10) .

02

“by the bounty of God and His mercy”

An explanation transmitted from Hilāl ibn Yasāf (Q 10:58).

347
Explanation from Hilāl ibn Yasāf No. 347: 2: 3

Hilāl ibn Yasāf

English
Transmission wording
347: 2:3. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Hilal ibn Yasaf:
"by the bounty of God and His mercy": He said, it is Islam and the Qur'an (verse 58).
العربية
347: 2: 3 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يساف بفضل الله وبرحمته قال هو الاسلام والقرآن (الآية 58) .
Edition record 371367 · p. 128Link to report ↗
03

“and make your houses a qibla”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 10:87).

348
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 348: 3: 1

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
348: 3:1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from Khusayf, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
"and make your houses a qibla": He said, make them places of prayer (verse 87).
العربية
348: 3: 1 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ بن عَبَّاسٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قبلة قال اجعلوها مساجد (الآية 87) .
Edition record 371367 · p. 128Link to report ↗
349
Report from Mujāhid No. 349: 4: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
349: 4:2. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, on His words
"your houses a qibla": They were afraid, so they were commanded to pray in their houses.
العربية
349: 4: 2 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قوله بيوتكم قبلة كَانُوا خَائفِينَ فَأُمِرُوا أَنْ يُصَلُّوا في بيوتهم.
